name: switchboard
description: Self-hostable web app to drive AI coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, ...) from your phone over Tailscale. Plugin-based.

scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && npm run build -w @switchboard/web
scripts.build:runtime: npm run build -w @switchboard/sdk && npm run build -w @switchboard/core && npm run build -w @switchboard/camera && npm run build -w @switchboard/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @switchboard/server" "npm run dev -w @switchboard/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:runtime && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:runtime && tsx --test packages/core/src/session-manager.test.ts packages/core/src/wrapper-backend.test.ts packages/server/src/ws-handler.test.ts packages/server/src/wrap-handler.test.ts packages/server/src/wrapper-cli.integration.test.ts
